force_group.create_relativity.spacetime_: Geodesic acceleration from nearby gravitational sources
config.create_relativity.physics.speed_o: Used in every dimension without an override. Low values make special relativity reachable; real c would make every effect invisible.
config.create_relativity.physics.unit_ra: Sable mass whose Schwarzschild radius is one block; sets the gravitational constant. Default block mass is 1.0.
config.create_relativity.physics.speed_o: Dimension id -> c in blocks/s. Planetoid space defaults higher so block planets aren't nearly black holes.
config.create_relativity.debug.show_radi: Draw horizon (purple), photon orbits (yellow) and ISCOs (cyan; dimmer = retrograde) around every black hole.
commands.create_relativity.bh.created: Black hole at %s %s %s: r_s=%s, spin=%s, mass=%s
commands.create_relativity.bh.none: No black holes in this dimension
Bend light around black holes (post-processing). Turn off if it clashes with a shader pack.
config.create_relativity.render.environm: Render a low-res 360° view from the nearest black hole (one face per frame) so light bent from off-screen, like the photon ring, shows what's really there.
config.create_relativity.render.capture_: How far the environment capture renders. Lower is cheaper.
config.create_relativity.render.overscan: While a black hole is visible, render the world this much wider than the screen so light bent in from just off-screen is real terrain instead of the blurrier capture. Costs a little sharpness; 0 turns it off.
